yearly_playable_pulse = { on_actions = { ck_ambition_yearly_pulse } }

ck_ambition_yearly_pulse = {
	trigger = {
		OR = {
			has_character_flag = ck_ambition_any
			AND = {
				is_independent_ruler = yes
				highest_held_title_tier >= tier_kingdom
			}
		}
	}
	effect = { ck_ambition_yearly_check_effect = yes }
}
